role: Shared helpers for the PhysioNet validation scripts (not ports of app code): WFDB beat-symbol sets, RR-point construction, agreement statistics (confusion/kappa/Bland-Altman), a minimal EDF channel reader.
state: DATA_ROOT (validation_common.py:11) = absolute path inside another Claude session's scratchpad (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/62b78298-.../scratchpad/physionet); every validate_* / cap_extract script reads data from it
COMMIT = 'e028039' (line 12, unused by importers; they hard-code the string)
toplevel: Module-level constants only (DATA_ROOT, COMMIT, symbol sets, CLASSES); imports numpy.

flags.text: DATA_ROOT is hard-coded to a scratchpad directory of a different (past) Claude session, so every validation script except test_ports.py/make_results.py fails with FileNotFoundError on any other machine until the constant is edited; RESULTS_template.md 'Reproducing' only says DATA_ROOT 'is set in validation_common.py'.

units.does: Filters a wfdb Annotation to [(sample:int, symbol)] keeping only symbols in BEAT_SYMBOLS, in annotation order.

Builds app-style RR points (t_ms, rr_ms) from consecutive beat pairs where BOTH beats are normal (N,L,R,e,j); t_ms = round(first beat sample/fs*1000), rr_ms = round(sample diff/fs*1000). Pairs touching a non-normal beat are skipped (a time gap in the output).

branches.cond: both beats of the pair are in NORMAL_SYMBOLS
branches.effect: true: append the (t_ms, rr_ms) point; false: pair omitted

units.does: Builds RR points (t_ms, rr_ms) from every consecutive annotated beat pair regardless of beat class (strap-like series).
Builds a len(classes)xlen(classes) integer confusion matrix (rows = reference, cols = prediction) from parallel label lists; an unknown label raises KeyError.
Cohen's kappa from a confusion matrix: (po-pe)/(1-pe).

branches.effect: true: returns kappa; false (all mass on one class in both marginals): returns NaN

units.does: Returns dict n, accuracy, kappa and per-class sens_<c> (recall over the reference row) and prec_<c> (over the prediction column); empty denominators yield NaN.
Bland-Altman of device-reference: returns n, bias (mean diff), sample SD (ddof=1), and 95% limits bias +/- 1.96 SD. Inputs containing None raise TypeError in np.asarray(..., float).

branches.effect: returns bias=mean (NaN if empty) and NaN sd/loa

units.does: Formats a number with nd decimals; None or NaN become 'n/a'.

branches.cond: x is None or a NaN float

units.does: Reads one EDF channel by exact label: parses the 256-byte header and per-signal headers, memory-maps the int16 data records, returns (physical float32 signal scaled by (pmax-pmin)/(dmax-dmin), sample rate nsamp/duration, start time string 'hh.mm.ss', all labels). Raises ValueError (labels.index) when the label is absent.

branches.cond: for each EDF per-signal header field

branches.effect: derives record count from file size; always then clamps nrec to what the file size can hold (line 119)

units.does: Nested helper: returns the stripped latin-1 text of per-signal header field i given the field's block offset and width (ns*off + i*width).
